parameters.name: AclId
parameters.description: The ID of the access control policy group.

parameters.name: AclStatus
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable access control. Valid values:
- **on**: enabled.
- **off**: disabled.

parameters.name: AclType
parameters.description:
The type of the access control policy. Valid values:

- **white**: allows the IPv6 addresses in the access control policy group to access backend services.

- **black**: denies the IPv6 addresses in the access control policy group from accessing backend services.

parameters.name: AllocateIpv6Addr
parameters.description: The IPv6 address allocated by the IPv6 Translation Service instance.

parameters.name: AllocateIpv6Port
parameters.description: The port used by the IPv6 address allocated by the IPv6 Translation Service instance.

parameters.name: BackendIpv4Addr
parameters.description: The public IPv4 address that requires IPv6 services.

parameters.name: BackendIpv4Port
parameters.description: The port used by the public IPv4 address that requires IPv6 services.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

parameters.name: EntryName
parameters.description: The name of the IPv6 Translation mapping entry.

parameters.name: Ipv6TranslatorEntryId
parameters.description:
The ID of the IPv6 Translation mapping entry to query. 

> If both **Ipv6TranslatorId** and **Ipv6TranslatorEntryId** are empty, all IPv6 Translation mapping entries are returned. If only **Ipv6TranslatorEntryId** is empty, all IPv6 Translation mapping entries under the current IPv6 Translation Service instance are returned.

parameters.name: Ipv6TranslatorId
parameters.description: The ID of the IPv6 Translation Service instance.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paging. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. You can call the **DescribeRegions** operation to query region IDs.

parameters.name: TransProtocol
parameters.description: The protocol type used for data forwarding.
